set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H04.1
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Performance/backend engineer
Scope: Define measurable local engineering acceptance before performance optimization.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H04 (bd-01M4X8M9GWYPFKAAZVHK760RSN)
Suggested delivery tranche: T1; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Create reproducible quick and stress corpus specifications with exact expected scientific/disclosure results, labs/projects, dataset/file/history counts, realistic metadata sizes and concurrent reader/writer/intake/export scenarios.
2. Record machine/container/JDK/DB resources and numeric p95 latency, memory, connection, queue, stream, storage-reserve and cancellation budgets before qualification; separate cold/warm runs and state a minimum sampling procedure.
3. Include the 10000-entry boundary and refusal above supported limits, long-lived downloads, skewed/hidden data and cursor misuse. Scope is synthetic engineering; any budget/corpus reduction requires a recorded reason and requalification, not silent benchmark tuning.

Verification: Versioned workload/budget manifest and deterministic content/query/permission oracle; no performance pass is claimed until H04.2.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H04.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- F01: bd-01M4W40J9S9Z7GFMS5DR2SZEV5
- L01.1: bd-01M4X5MA1AAA6MXNK2PWBAYYP1

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H04.1: Freeze the engineering workload corpus and performance budgets
